g.text: Microdrama Platform FlareFlow Sets Thailand Launch on AIS Play (EXCLUSIVE) ◆ Mohammad Rasoulof, Shahrbanoo Sadat Push Back on Idea of Separate Oscar Category for Exiled Filmmakers as Cate Blanchett’s Displacement Film Fund Hits Toky ◆ Annecy Winner ‘The Violinist’ Found Its Italian Co-Producers at Tokyo Market, Director Ervin Han Tells Anime Co-Production Panel ◆ Taiwanese Feature ‘Uncle’ Wins Top Prize at Tokyo Gap-Financing Market Awards ◆ Gay Filipino Couple’s Homecoming Documentary ‘We Had a Plan’ Boarded by Cat&Docs Ahead of IDFA Premiere, Trailer Unveiled (EXCLUSIVE) ◆ Japan’s Anime Market Hits Record $28.2 Billion as Local Sales Surge ◆
